reviews.quote: As a new author, I had no idea how book marketing worked. I started with about 70 sales, mostly from friends and family. The team explained their Email Marketing & Newsletter Promotion service clearly, so I decided to give it a try. After the first campaign, my book reached 560 reviews. I reordered the service, and it eventually reached 1,800 reviews. I'm genuinely impressed with the results and the support throughout the process. I highly recommend them to authors looking to reach a much larger audience.
